kind: Diagnostic draw ablation, not a shipped optimization
sourceChanges: Frame-stat/history profiling additions; no visual defaults changed
protocol: Two A-B-B-A sequences; 20 seconds per arm; discard first window and retain three 5-second windows. A original star masks, B masks zero. Only the two star objects are excluded; light banks preserved.
limits: GPU values are sparse medians, not whole-run or tail percentiles.
The live copied world evolves during the run; populations, draw counts and programs are not completely fixed.
Controls show large FPS variation. Do not claim an FPS gain from this capture.
